stderr_redirect_strategy: sys.stderr = /dev/null via python3 -c wrapper (suppresses cmd_parse's print(f'Error: {e}', file=sys.stderr) — Atheris progress unaffected because libFuzzer writes to fd 2 directly via libc)
notes: First attempted run with no redirect filled disk to 100% in ~2 minutes (5.2GB logs of Error: ... lines from cmd_parse). Re-ran with sys.stderr monkeypatched to /dev/null. Achieved 134M iters in 300s with no crashes, no leaks, no oracle mismatches. Note: initial run's 0-byte 'crash-<hash>' files in crashes/cli_parse/ were Atheris artifacts from the OSError 28 disk-full event, NOT real findings — removed in re-run.
